summary.headline: Charts do not show a lopsided excess

No audit trail was received. 26 of 26 notes claiming moderate-or-higher data reviewed had no lab or test line on the claim. 33 charts pooled, 9% below billed, rule not triggered; no demand. C0002181: billed 99215, patient aged 51 with 1 chronic condition(s) (hyperlipidemia). C0002304: billed 99215, patient aged 50 with 0 chronic condition(s).
